## V.7
- **EMET:** "And-from-vessels-of house-of YHWH brought Nebuchadnezzar to-Babylon and-he-put-them in-his-temple in-Babylon."
- **LOGOS:** "Nebuchadnezzar also carried part of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon and put them in his palace in Babylon."
- **PNEUMA:** "Nebuchadnezzar also took articles from the LORD's temple to Babylon and put them in his temple there."
